A celebrated writer born in Chicago who at first plied her trade inNew York, Greer spent most of her adult life in theUK. She took up dual citizenship and became a regular and prominent political commentator in Britain. Greer's widower Hutchins hailed her as "an acclaimed playwright, author, critic, cultural and political commentator whose intelligence, courage and distinctive voice made an enduring contribution to British cultural and public life." Hutchins said his late wife had suffered succumbed to a brief illness. He said those closest to Greer would remember her warmth, humor, generosity and extraordinary ability to bring people together. "To me, she was my partner, confidante and inspiration, and I feel profoundly privileged to have shared my life with her," Hutchins said. The pair married in 1993, seven years after Greer emigrated. Greer was born in Chicago in 1948, the eldest of seven children from a family of Mississippi sharecroppers. Her familial exposure to the UK predated even her birth — her father Ben was stationed in Britain duringWorld War IIand had taken part in the D-Day landings. She gravitated towards creative writing amid the civil rights movement in the US after a college professor told her he did not believe women should pursue a legal career. Having studied theater in Chicago she moved to New York as a young aspiring writer.

full_text: تبرعت بأرض لإنشائها.. بكاء أُم في مصر لحظة افتتاح مدرسة تحمل اسم ابنها الراحل تفاعل واسع في مصر مع دموع أم مسنة لحظة افتتاح مدرسة تحمل اسم ابنها الراحل. حفظ شارِكْ تصدرت أُم فيمصرمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي بعد ظهور مؤثر لها في مقطع مصور أثناء افتتاح مدرسة تحمل اسم ابنها الراحل. الأم هي "الحاجة أم خالد"، التي تبرعت بقطعة أرض لبناء مدرسة تحمل اسم ابنها "خالد محمد صلاح" في قرية "كفر جبارة" بمحافظة الشرقية. المقطع المصور يظهر لحظة افتتاح المحافظ حازم الأشموني للمدرسة وإزاحة الستار عن اللوحة التذكارية، موجها حديثه إلى الأم قائلا: "انظري، مدرسة خالد محمد صلاح"، لتبكي الأم شوقا لابنها الراحل. وبعدها، اصطحب المسؤول الأم إلى كرسي قريب لتجلس عليه، بعد أن بدا عليها التأثر الشديد. المشهد لاقى تفاعلا واسعا، وأشاد مستخدمو منصات التواصل الاجتماعي بما فعلته الأم، معربين عن مواساتهم لها، ودعائهم لها بالصبر ولابنها بالرحمة. وأقيمت المدرسة على مساحة 1339 مترا مربعا، وتتكون من 5 طوابق بتكلفة بلغت أكثر من 19 مليون جنيه (أكثر من 370 ألف دولار).

A Senior Transplant Coordinator at King’s College Hospital and Honorary Senior Lecturer at the University of Salford, Agimol co-founded the Upahaar initiative after identifying the disproportionate challenges faced by South Asian patients waiting for transplants. The initiative has since registered more than 10,000 stem-cell donors. A native of Kerala, Agimol moved to the United Kingdom in 2001 and went on to build a career spanning transplant care, nursing education, research and community advocacy. Her work began with a question that emerged during her academic research: why were some South Asian patients waiting years for a transplant while other patients were receiving organs within months. Lt General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhury was asked, in an interview withAl Arabiya English, how concerned Pakistan was about developments in India’s air defence, missile and conventional strike capabilities. In response, he said Pakistan “respects” Indian military capabilities and understands New Delhi’s efforts to invest in its defence arsenal. However, he maintained that Pakistan was focused on defensive capabilities and had “no aggressive design” against any country. “We respect the Indian military capabilities. We understand their desire to spend lots of money and resources in building up their military arsenal and capabilities,” Chaudhury said. “However, that doesn't mean that we are into any sort of arms race with Indians.” The remarks come as India continues to expand its indigenous defence manufacturing base while also working with established partners on advanced military platforms. India’s push has gained further momentum since Operation Sindoor, with greater emphasis on strengthening capabilities that could be relevant in a potential two-front security scenario.
